entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2026-11-03
entry.content:
Google.Cloud.BackupDR.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta02

New features

  • Add Backup and DR AutoProtection v1 public protobuf definitions and update v1beta AutoProtection annotations

Documentation improvements

  • Update AutoProtection field documentation comments in v1 and v1beta

Google.Cloud.Chronicle.V1 version 1.2.0

New features

  • Introduce v1 client library support for Chronicle SearchService

Google.Cloud.SecretManager.V1 version 3.0.0

New features

  • Add top-level CloudSqlSingleUserCredentials message in resources.proto for Cloud SQL single-user managed rotation

Bug fixes

  • Update EnableManagedRotationRequest in service.proto to reference top-level CloudSqlSingleUserCredentials and rename oneof credentials to oneof credential

Google.Cloud.NetworkManagement.V1 version 2.22.0

New features

  • Add Datastream private connection

Google.Cloud.Iam.Admin.V1 version 2.6.0

New features

  • Workforce Identity Federation background attribute sync logging

Google.Cloud.DocumentAI.V1Beta3 version 2.0.0-beta31

New features

  • Add ProcessorVersion.grounding_settings and the GroundingSettings and ProcessorVersionOverrides messages
  • Add processor_version_overrides to TrainProcessorVersionRequest

Google.Cloud.DiscoveryEngine.V1 version 1.17.0

New features

  • Add CreateAssistant, GetAssistant, ListAssistants, UpdateAssistant and DeleteAssistant RPCs to AssistantService
  • Add display_name, description, generation_config, web_grounding_type, default_web_grounding_toggle_off, enabled_tools, customer_policy, create_time and update_time fields to Assistant
  • Add AclConfigService and AclConfig resource
  • Add CollectionService and Collection resource
  • Add DataConnectorService and DataConnector resource
  • Add LicenseConfigService and LicenseConfig resource
  • Add UserStoreService and UserStore resource
  • Add WidgetConfigService and WidgetConfig resource
  • Add Create, Get, List and Delete RPCs to ServingConfigService
  • Add GetIamPolicy and SetIamPolicy RPCs to CollectionService, DataStoreService and EngineService
  • Add AdvancedCompleteQuery RPC to CompletionService
  • Add ListLicenseConfigsUsageStats RPC to UserLicenseService
  • Add AgentGatewaySetting, Feedback and logging messages
  • Add new fields to existing messages across the v1 surface
  • Add discoveryengine.readwrite, discoveryengine.serving.readwrite, discoveryengine.assist.readwrite and cloud_search.query OAuth scopes
  • Add resource definitions for AgentGateway, Model Armor Template, DLP ContentPolicy, Service Directory Service and Notebook

Documentation improvements

  • Update comments and field_behavior annotations on existing v1 messages, services and enums

Google.Cloud.DeveloperConnect.V1 version 1.0.0-beta05

New features

  • Add Normalized SCM methods for Git repository links

Google.Cloud.Datastore.V1 version 5.4.0

Bug fixes

  • Allow null values in GQL query parameter helpers

Google.Cloud.Compute.V1 version 4.2.0

New features

  • Update Compute Engine v1 API artifacts to revision 20261016
  • Add MEMORY_OPTIMIZED_M4N and MEMORY_OPTIMIZED_M4N_6TB values to Commitment.Type enum

Documentation improvements

  • Update documentation in proto definitions
